setup: Left home at 8am to beat Silk Board traffic.
punchline: Reached office just in time for the evening standup.
caption: Silk Board is not a junction, it is a lifestyle.

setup: Google Maps: 'You will reach in 12 minutes.'
punchline: Bangalore: 'That is cute. Try 55.'
caption: Maps has never met Outer Ring Road.

setup: Auto driver, can you go by meter?
punchline: He laughed so hard he had to pull over.
caption: Meter is decoration only, guru.

setup: Landlord: rent is reasonable.
punchline: Deposit: only 10 months. Swalpa adjust maadi.
caption: Deposit so big it needs its own PAN card.

setup: Bangalore weather at 7am: jacket.
punchline: 1pm: sunscreen. 5pm: umbrella. 9pm: jacket again.
caption: Four seasons, one day, zero warning.

setup: It drizzled for 10 minutes.
punchline: Now my road is a lake with a speed breaker.
caption: Namma roads have water features now.

setup: Met someone at a cafe in Koramangala.
punchline: Within 3 minutes he pitched me his startup.
caption: Every coffee here comes with a free pitch deck.

setup: Asked for filter coffee without sugar.
punchline: The darshini uncle looked at me like I insulted his family.
caption: Sakkath coffee needs sakkath sugar.

setup: Namma Metro is so efficient.
punchline: Now if only it went where I actually need to go.
caption: Almost there. Every year. Almost there.

setup: Doctor: avoid stress and bumpy rides.
punchline: Me, living in Bangalore: noted.
caption: Potholes are free chiropractic sessions.

setup: Broker: the flat is 5 minutes from the metro.
punchline: 5 minutes by helicopter.
caption: Broker minutes are not real minutes.

setup: Friend: let us meet halfway.
punchline: Indiranagar to HSR halfway is a 2 hour trip.
caption: Halfway in Bangalore is a road trip.

setup: Weekend plan: brunch, movie, drinks.
punchline: Actual weekend: stuck at Hebbal flyover for all three.
caption: Weekend plans die at the first signal.

setup: Cab app: surge 1.0x
punchline: Two drops of rain later: surge 3.8x.
caption: The clouds and the cab apps are in a partnership.

setup: No water in the building today.
punchline: The tanker guy is now my most important contact.
caption: Saved as: Tanker Anna, do not ignore.

setup: Bar closes at 1am.
punchline: Bangalore techies at 12:55: one more round, macha.
caption: Last call is a sprint, not a suggestion.

setup: The BMTC bus did not stop at the stop.
punchline: It stopped 50 metres later. Cardio included.
caption: Free gym membership with every bus pass.

setup: Moved to Bangalore for the pleasant weather.
punchline: Now I spend it all inside a cab.
caption: The weather is great. I hear.

setup: Learned my first Kannada words: swalpa adjust maadi.
punchline: Turns out it solves 90 percent of problems here.
caption: The most powerful sentence in the city.

setup: Nandi Hills sunrise plan: leave at 4am.
punchline: Reached at 7. Saw the sun already at work.
caption: The sun does not wait for traffic.

setup: Two people in Bangalore meet.
punchline: First question: which company? Second: which layout?
caption: Your layout is your personality now.

setup: I do not own a car in Bangalore.
punchline: I own a subscription to three cab apps.
caption: Car EMI replaced by surge EMI.

setup: The traffic signal turned green.
punchline: Nobody moved. Nobody could.
caption: Green means go, in theory.

setup: Bangalore has the best weather in India.
punchline: We know, because we tell you every single day.
caption: Humble brag, daily delivery.

setup: Found a flat with good water supply, low rent, great location.
punchline: Then I woke up.
caption: Dream flats only exist in dreams.

setup: Auto driver: 'Where do you want to go?'
punchline: Me: 'Where do YOU want to go?' That is how it works here.
caption: The auto picks the destination, not you.

setup: My commute is 12 kilometres.
punchline: I have finished two audiobooks and a life crisis.
caption: Long commute, deep thoughts.

setup: Friend from Delhi: it is so cold here!
punchline: It was 19 degrees.
caption: Bangalore winter is a light breeze with ambition.

setup: Saw a flyover under construction in 2019.
punchline: Visited it again today. It remembers me.
caption: Some things grow slower than startups.

setup: Ordered food. Delivery time: 25 minutes.
punchline: Delivery guy also stuck at Silk Board. We bonded.
caption: United by traffic.

setup: New Bangalore resident: I will cycle to work!
punchline: Day 1: bought a cycle. Day 2: bought a cab pass.
caption: Good intentions, bad potholes.

setup: Meetings in Bangalore start at 10.
punchline: Unless the person is coming from Whitefield. Then 11:30.
caption: Whitefield time is its own time zone.

setup: Tried to find parking on Church Street.
punchline: Found inner peace instead. Still no parking.
caption: Parking is a myth, like a quiet weekend.

setup: My landlord said no non veg, no pets, no guests.
punchline: Basically, no life, pay rent on time.
caption: House rules longer than my lease.

setup: First rain of the season in Bangalore.
punchline: Half the city posts it on Instagram. The other half is stuck in it.
caption: Rain: 50 percent aesthetic, 50 percent traffic.

setup: Everyone in Bangalore has a side project.
punchline: Even my auto driver has a YouTube channel.
caption: Hustle culture reached the auto stand.

setup: Asked the waiter for water.
punchline: He asked: normal, cold, or Bisleri? Life choices, guru.
caption: Even water has options here.

setup: Bangalore uncle at the park: 'In my days, this was all trees.'
punchline: Uncle, in my days this was all traffic. Same days.
caption: Garden city, now traffic city.

setup: Took the metro for the first time.
punchline: Felt like a tourist in my own city. Clean, fast, and slightly confusing.
caption: Namma Metro, namma pride.

setup: Friend: why are you late?
punchline: Me: I live in Bangalore. Next question.
caption: The only excuse everyone accepts.

setup: Wanted to go to Mysore for the weekend.
punchline: Spent Saturday just exiting Bangalore.
caption: Leaving the city is the real trip.

setup: Bangalore rent went up again.
punchline: My salary heard this and went into hiding.
caption: Rent hike season never ends.

setup: The auto driver asked 'extra 20 rupees?'
punchline: The only negotiation I have ever lost in under 5 seconds.
caption: Master negotiators, all of them.

setup: Tech park lunch conversation:
punchline: Stocks, startups, and whose flyover is slower.
caption: Topics of the day, every day.

setup: I love the Bangalore breeze.
punchline: Especially when it carries the smell of fresh dosa.
caption: Air quality: mostly benne dosa.

setup: CTR benne dosa queue was only 20 minutes.
punchline: That is the fastest thing in Malleshwaram.
caption: Worth every minute of the queue.

setup: Road was freshly laid last week.
punchline: This week they dug it up for a cable.
caption: Roads here are a subscription service.

setup: My Bangalore friend says 'I will be there in 5 minutes.'
punchline: Translation: I have not left home yet.
caption: Bangalore minutes are elastic.

setup: New job offer: great pay, office in Electronic City.
punchline: Me, living in Hebbal: I will think about it for 3 hours of traffic.
caption: Location decides everything.

setup: Bangalore pub menu: craft beer, 40 types.
punchline: Me: one that costs less than my Uber home.
caption: The beer is cheap. The ride home is not.

setup: The building security uncle knows everything.
punchline: Who ordered what, who came late, and who owes maintenance.
caption: The real CEO of every apartment.

setup: I finally understood Bangalore addresses.
punchline: 4th cross, 8th main, near temple, opposite big tree. Easy.
caption: GPS is useless, the big tree is king.

setup: Bangalore conversation starter:
punchline: So, how was traffic? Then 30 minutes of shared trauma.
caption: Therapy, but free.

setup: Tried to cross the road at Majestic.
punchline: Now I respect every Olympic athlete.
caption: Crossing the road here needs a strategy deck.

setup: Swiggy guy arrived in 10 minutes.
punchline: My friend who lives next door took 40.
caption: Delivery partners know shortcuts we do not.

setup: Everyone in Bangalore owns a hoodie.
punchline: And uses it for exactly 11 days a year.
caption: Hoodie season is short but strong.

setup: Found a quiet cafe to work from.
punchline: Next day, 30 laptops and three startup founders.
caption: Every quiet cafe becomes a coworking space.

setup: Bangalore Sunday morning:
punchline: Idli, vada, filter coffee, and a strong nap strategy.
caption: The perfect Sunday formula.

setup: Asked my colleague where he lives.
punchline: He said 'near Marathahalli.' That is 40 percent of the city.
caption: Near Marathahalli covers a lot of ground.

setup: Bangalore flyover logic:
punchline: Build it, name it, and let traffic move under it too.
caption: Flyovers with bonus traffic.

setup: The auto meter started at 30.
punchline: The driver started at 150.
caption: Two meters, one ride.

setup: My plants love Bangalore weather.
punchline: They are the only ones not complaining about traffic.
caption: Plants are living their best life.

setup: Bangalore techie vacation:
punchline: Goes to Coorg, opens laptop, 'just one quick call.'
caption: Workation is just work with a view.

setup: Decided to wake up early and beat traffic.
punchline: Traffic also woke up early. Great minds.
caption: You cannot beat it. You can only join it.

setup: Mom on the phone: 'Are you eating properly?'
punchline: Me, on my third plate of bisi bele bath: yes, swalpa.
caption: Eating properly is not a problem here.

setup: My flatmate said the gas cylinder is empty.
punchline: Worst sentence to hear on a Sunday morning.
caption: Cylinder anxiety is real.

setup: Bangalore sky at 6pm:
punchline: Beautiful sunset. Seen from inside a stuck cab. Still beautiful.
caption: Silver lining of every traffic jam.

setup: The power went out for 2 minutes.
punchline: Entire WFH floor let out one collective scream.
caption: Two minutes feels like two years on a Zoom call.

setup: Visited Lalbagh for some peace.
punchline: Found 300 people also looking for peace.
caption: Peace, with a crowd.

setup: My neighbour said 'let us do lunch sometime.'
punchline: In Bangalore that means we will meet in 2028.
caption: Plans made, plans postponed.

setup: Got a window seat in the metro.
punchline: Best day of the month. Told everyone.
caption: Small wins, big joy.

setup: Cab driver cancelled after 12 minutes.
punchline: He was 3 minutes away the whole time. Spiritually.
caption: Driver is always 3 minutes away. Forever.

setup: Bangalore gym at 7am:
punchline: Half are working out, half are on work calls on the treadmill.
caption: Multitasking, Bangalore style.

setup: The sign said 'road closed for work.'
punchline: Since 2021. Very dedicated work.
caption: Long term projects only.

setup: Bangalore grocery delivery in 10 minutes.
punchline: Walking to the store takes 15 because of the footpath situation.
caption: The footpath is an obstacle course.

setup: Friend visiting from Mumbai: 'Your traffic is bad.'
punchline: Me: finally, someone who understands.
caption: Traffic solidarity across cities.

setup: My plans for the rainy evening:
punchline: Hot bajji, filter coffee, and not going anywhere.
caption: The only good response to Bangalore rain.

setup: Apartment WhatsApp group has 400 messages.
punchline: 398 about water, 2 about a missing cat.
caption: Water updates are the real news.

setup: I said 'Bengaluru' once in a meeting.
punchline: Three people corrected me to Bangalore, two back to Bengaluru.
caption: Both are right, macha.

setup: Dentist asked how I cracked my tooth.
punchline: Pothole on Old Airport Road. He nodded. He knew.
caption: Every doctor here knows the potholes.

setup: Bangalore Saturday night:
punchline: Leave for the party at 9, reach at 10:30, pub closes at 1.
caption: Party time is limited, traffic time is not.

setup: The weather app said 'sunny'.
punchline: Bangalore took that personally and poured for 3 hours.
caption: Never trust the weather app here.

setup: My office moved closer to my home.
punchline: Commute went from 90 minutes to 85.
caption: Every minute saved is a victory.

setup: Tried to explain Bangalore traffic to my foreign colleague.
punchline: He asked if it was a festival. I said yes, every day.
caption: The daily traffic festival.

setup: Bangalore darshini rules:
punchline: Stand, eat fast, drink coffee, leave. No emotions allowed.
caption: Efficiency, darshini style.

setup: Asked for directions near Jayanagar.
punchline: Uncle gave me directions, his life story, and a coffee recommendation.
caption: Namma people, namma pride.

setup: Airport cab from the city:
punchline: Pay more for the ride than the flight to Goa.
caption: The airport is basically in another district.

setup: My friend moved from Bangalore to another city.
punchline: Now he calls every week to complain about their weather.
caption: Once you have Bangalore weather, nothing else works.

setup: Traffic police at the junction waved us through.
punchline: All 400 vehicles moved together like a symphony. Of horns.
caption: The orchestra of Bangalore roads.

setup: New year resolution: complain less about traffic.
punchline: Lasted until January 2, 9:15am.
caption: Some resolutions are just impossible.
